name: Berupipam
summary: Berupipam is a selective dopamine D1 receptor antagonist of the benzazepine group which was under development for the treatment of psychotic disorders but was never marketed. It reached phase 1 clinical trials prior to the discontinuation of its development.

pharmacology.text: Berupipam (INN; developmental code name NNC 22-0010) is a selective dopamine D1 receptor antagonist of the benzazepine group which was under development for the treatment of psychotic disorders but was never marketed.

uses.text: Berupipam (INN; developmental code name NNC 22-0010) is a selective dopamine D1 receptor antagonist of the benzazepine group which was under development for the treatment of psychotic disorders but was never marketed. It reached phase 1 clinical trials prior to the discontinuation of its development. Berupipam, in radiolabeled form, has been studied for use in positron emission tomography (PET) imaging.

fact.en: It blocks the dopamine D1 receptor rather than D2, which almost every antipsychotic targets. Trials of D1 blockers generally failed to show the hoped for effect on psychosis.
fact.zh: 它阻斷多巴胺 D1 受體，而非幾乎所有抗精神病藥所針對的 D2 受體。D1 阻斷劑的試驗普遍未能顯示出對精神病的預期效果。
fact.zhHans: 它阻断多巴胺 D1 受体，而非几乎所有抗精神病药所针对的 D2 受体。D1 阻断剂的试验普遍未能显示出对精神病的预期效果。
